# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Charts — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 10 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Duration — 3 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the lane theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--canvas, #faf8f3);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="night" or "cacao" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--canvas, #121110);   /* the night theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #faf8f3;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | lane | night | cacao | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--canvas` | #faf8f3 | #121110 | #faf2e6 | Page ground behind everything. Cacao: the brand's cream; it has no second surface. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #1c1b19 | #faf2e6 | Raised slabs: product cards, panels, toasts' light theme siblings, popovers. Equals canvas in Cacao, where cards are drawn with line instead of a fill. |
| `--surface-sunk` | #f0ece3 | #272522 | #f1e4d2 | Wells and tracks: meter and progress tracks, stepper body, skeleton base, hover highlight in pickers. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css

color: var(--ink, #1c1a17);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="night" or "cacao" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */

```

### Tokens (2)

| token | lane | night | cacao | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #1c1a17 | #f3efe7 | #2d1a10 | Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-sunk and every *-soft fill (at least 4.5:1 in all themes). Also the selected-pill fill in pickers. |
| `--ink-muted` | #625c53 | #aaa398 | #69574c | Secondary text: vendor names, captions, helper lines, compare-at prices, on canvas, surface and surface-sunk (at least 4.5:1). |

### Tokens (5)

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-accent` | #1c1a17 | #1c1a17 | #faf2e6 | Text and icons on accent fills (at least 4.5:1). Dark ink on marigold, cream on terracotta. |

| token | lane | night | cacao | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the lane theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #e5dfd3);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="night" or "cacao" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #2f2d29);   /* the night theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e5dfd3;
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | lane | night | cacao | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #e5dfd3 | #2f2d29 | #c9bdb1 | Decorative hairlines and card outlines. Too faint for a control edge on its own. |
| `--line-strong` | #8c8579 | #77705f | #69574c | Control borders: inputs, OTP boxes, stepper and picker outlines (at least 3:1 on canvas and surface). |
| `--accent` | #f2a516 | #f5b335 | #a74a04 | The one action colour: the primary Add to bag button and nothing else per view. Lane is marigold; Cacao is terracotta. |
| `--inverse` | #1c1a17 | #f3efe7 | #2d1a10 | Inverted fills: toasts, tooltips, the selected size pill, the chart hover card. |
| `--success` | #0d6e85 | #5cc8e0 | #1f5f74 | Success states with a word or tick beside them: Added, Delivered, code verified, free delivery unlocked. Text on canvas, surface and success-soft. Leans blue so it never relies on a red/green split. |
| `--success-soft` | #dcf0f4 | #10313a | #dcebee | Ground behind success text and the verified OTP boxes. |
| `--danger` | #b3261e | #ff8a7a | #a74a04 | Errors and destructive confirms, always with a word: wrong code, Remove item?. Text on canvas, surface and danger-soft. Cacao reuses terracotta, as its brand book says. |
| `--danger-soft` | #fbe4e1 | #3d1612 | #f6e4d0 | Ground behind danger text and the errored OTP boxes. |
| `--love` | #d4264f | #ff5d7f | #a74a04 | The filled wishlist heart and its burst (a mark, at least 3:1 on canvas and surface). |
| `--focus` | #1c1a17 | #f3efe7 | #a74a04 | Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (at least 3:1 on canvas and surface). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 40px/44px "Instrument Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-type-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type-display` | `.type-display`, `--text-type-display` | 40px / 44px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | One big statement per screen: ETA on the tracker, the order-confirmed line. |
| `type-kpi` | `.type-kpi`, `--text-type-kpi` | 28px / 32px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | Dashboard totals and the stacked-bars headline number. Tabular figures. |
| `type-title` | `.type-title`, `--text-type-title` | 18px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Card and panel titles; product name on the product page. |
| `type-body` | `.type-body`, `--text-type-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Default reading text. |
| `type-label` | `.type-label`, `--text-type-label` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Buttons, pills, toast titles, form labels. |
| `type-price` | `.type-price`, `--text-type-price` | 16px / 22px | 600 | `sans` | Prices. Always tabular figures, en-IN grouping. |
| `type-caption` | `.type-caption`, `--text-type-caption` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.01em | 500 | `sans` | Vendor lines, legends, step labels, helper text. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Instrument Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps, digit gaps in the OTP row. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gaps inside pills and between chips. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Card inner padding on mobile; toast padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding; gap between product cards. |
| `--space-5` | 24px | Section padding inside panels. |
| `--space-6` | 32px | Gap between page sections inside a screen. |

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 8px | OTP boxes, inputs, small chips. |
| `--radius-md` | 14px | Product image corners, panels, meters. |

| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Anything you press: buttons, size pills, steppers, segmented controls. |

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.06) in the lane theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-card), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-card` | 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.06) · night: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) · cacao: none | Resting cards. Cacao has no soft card shadow; cards there are hairline-framed. |
| `--shadow-float` | 0 12px 32px rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.18) · night: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) · cacao: 0 18px 50px rgba(45, 26, 16, 0.35) | Floating chrome: toasts, chart hover card, lifted cards on hover. |

## Duration

Motion timing. Read as CSS custom properties; drop to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion (bundle.css does this).

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--dur-fast: 140ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--dur-fast), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dur-fast` | 140ms | Hover fills, colour changes, press-down. |
| `--dur-base` | 240ms | Pill glides, image swaps, toast fan-out. |
| `--dur-slow` | 520ms | Number rolls, meter fills, progress steps. |

## Easing

Curves. The spring overshoots slightly and is kept for confirmations only.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--ease-out), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ease-out` | cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) | Default for anything entering or settling. |
| `--ease-spring` | cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) | Confirmations: heart pop, tick draw, selected pill landing, digit roll. |
| `--ease-in-out` | cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) | Shimmer sweeps and looping pulses. |
